messages:
Alan Tse: quick sync w/ @skybridge-qa — we need to align on the perf calibration plan for next week's joint run. propose: 2 phases: (1) wattmeter calibration & idle baseline, (2) kernel tuning + throughput ramp. details below.

Maria Gomez: +1. can we standardize telemetry format? CSV with headers: run_id, model, batch, seq_len, tokens, p95_latency_ms, avg_power_w, throughput_tps, kernel_sha

Devon Park: pinging bench-bot for harness link

bench-bot: /run-harness --repo=redwood/throughput-harness --commit=main --profile=skybridge-calibration

Priya Rao: i've uploaded powerstrip calibration notes to the drive: https://drive.redwood/sb-calib. use NIST trace for wattmeter offset.

Tom B: for kernel builds, use kernel-rt-5.15 + our opt patchset. patchset id: rwinf/kpatch/2026a

skybridge-qa: we can expose per-core power and NIC counters. need exact metrics list — can you confirm the CSV schema?

Alan Tse: confirmed schema: run_id, partner, model, model_size, batch, seq_len, tokens, p95_ms, median_ms, avg_power_w, peak_power_w, throughput_tps, kernel_version, kernel_patch_id, notes

Maria Gomez: success criteria: 10% perf/W improvement margin target vs baseline OR matching Redwood's 95% latency target at target throughput. document decisions in run log.

Devon Park: questions: which models? recommend: gpt-mini (2B), gpt-slim (7B), gpt-core (70B) with quantized variants.

Priya Rao: schedule: kickoff 2026-05-03 16:00 PT for calibration, run slot 05-04 02:00-08:00 PT (offpeak). is that ok for skybridge?

skybridge-qa: 05-03 kickoff works. need an SRE contact for network flaps.

Alan Tse: assign @Tom B for SRE; @Devon will own gitops and harness; @Maria will lead eval criteria. I'll own partner comms.

Tom B: ack. i'll add a brief failover playbook to the run doc.

Devon Park: quick note on reproducibility — include seeds.txt and full dockerfile + run command. example:
```
docker run --rm -v /data:/data redwood/harness:latest \
  ./run_bench --model gpt-slim --batch 8 --seq 2048 --tokens 50000 --out results.csv
```

Maria Gomez: can we also collect perf counters: L2_misses, L3_misses, mem_bw_gbps, pci_xfer_gbps — helpful for kernel tuning.

skybridge-qa: we'll expose those via /metrics endpoint and include a short summary per-run.

bench-bot: created task T-4872: "Skybridge calibration run orchestration" due 2026-05-06

Alan Tse: OK. action items:
- Tom: SRE playbook + wattmeter hookup diagram
- Devon: harness CI + example run command
- Maria: eval rubric + success thresholds
- Priya: vendor drive + schedule
- skybridge-qa: confirm power meter firmware and metrics export

Alan Tse: I'll post a concise run checklist in the run doc tonight. tagging @everyone :rocket:

Maria Gomez: thanks all. small ask: keep logs compressed (gzip) and name them run_<run_id>_YYYYMMDD.tar.gz so transfer is faster.

skybridge-qa: noted. we'll also keep the BMC logs and attach.

Devon Park: adding a short snippet to parse CSV to produce perf/W curve in python:
```
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('results.csv')
agg = df.groupby('batch').apply(lambda g: (g['throughput_tps'].sum()/g['avg_power_w'].mean()))
print(agg)
```

Alan Tse: perfect. see you on the kickoff.
